content:
priya: Heads up -- planning to flip the kyber GPU pool autoscale policy TONIGHT during low-traffic window (01:30 UTC). Canary on 2 nodes, 30m watch. Swap is latency-first -> cost-aware (reduce burst aggressiveness). Any blockers?

kevin: LGTM. What's the smoke checklist?

priya: Smoke plan:
1) run quick load from perf-job:
```
python perf_runner.py --pool kyber --concurrency 100 --seq-len 512 --duration 60
```
2) monitor metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, GPU util. Stop if p95 > 350ms or tokens/sec drops >10%
3) sanity: run 10 inference calls against `/healthz` and check KV-cache hits > 80%

Also will push policy bump to config: `autoscale_profile: cost-aware; scale_up_threshold: 0.6; scale_down_cooldown: 300s`

dina: I'll watch the dashboard and have alerts open. Link: https://console.redwood/observability/dashboards/kyber-autoscale

ryan: I'll own rollback. If we need to revert:
```
# rollback autoscaler deployment
kubectl rollout undo deployment/kyber-autoscaler -n kyber
# restore policy
redwoodctl config set autoscale/kyber profile=latency-first scale_up_threshold=0.75 scale_down_cooldown=120
```

sam: Do we need to notify Dedicated customers? Any config change that affects reserved slices?

priya: No reserved slices changes. It's purely autoscale tuning; only affects burst behavior. I'll send a quick status note to dedicated-customers channel before flip.

deploy-bot: Deploy window scheduled by priya at 2026-03-18T01:30:00Z (canary:2; max-rollout: 20%)

sre-oncall: I'll standby for 01:30 UTC. Ping me if we hit the p95 threshold or increased error rate.

kevin: I've got a quick CR on the config change (small docstring nit). Priya — can you add a short comment in the policy YAML about why lowering threshold?

priya: Will do. Also adding smoke run to runbook: `runbook/kyber-autoscale-flip.md`

dina: :thumbsup: Ready for 01:30 UTC

ryan: Ready to rollback if needed. Add me to the incident channel if smoke fails.

priya: Thanks everyone. I'll post a short note in #dedicated-customers 15m before flip and then kick the change. ETA 01:30 UTC, watch window 30m. If no regression, we'll finalize at 02:00 UTC and remove canary flag.

kevin: ack

sam: ack

deploy-bot: Deploy started 2026-03-18T01:30:05Z (canary nodes: kyber-2a, kyber-2b)

priya: smoke run kicking off now

(End of thread)
